# The Astra Forge

> The Astra Forge (theastraforge.com) is a global AI video editing agency serving brands, creators and businesses worldwide — USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia and beyond.

## What we do
- Talking-head video editing (YouTube, courses, podcasts)
- AI UGC ads for e-commerce and DTC brands (Shopify, Amazon sellers)
- AI avatar / spokesperson videos (no filming needed)
- Short-form video: Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts
- Product videos and 3D product animation
- Explainer and demo videos for SaaS and startups

## Key facts
- 100% remote, serving clients worldwide across all time zones
- AI-powered workflow: faster turnaround (48-hour delivery available)
- Free sample edit for new clients
- Portfolio of real client work streams on the site (no YouTube redirect)
- Pricing: Starter $499/mo, Growth $899/mo, Scale $1499/mo (see /#pricing)

## Who we serve
Real estate agents, coaches and course creators, Shopify/DTC brands, restaurants, law firms, dentists and clinics, fitness coaches, SaaS companies, podcasters and YouTubers — in the USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia and worldwide.
